scope: Specified application acceptance scenarios. No application tests have been executed by this planning package.

cases.title: Only three configured pilots are accepted
cases.expected: Unknown area ID is rejected; whole borough is not silently selected.

cases.title: Geometry coordinate conversion
cases.expected: Known GeoJSON lng/lat fixture converts correctly to Police.uk lat,lng polygon syntax.

cases.title: Invalid geometry
cases.expected: Self-intersection, invalid ring, wrong CRS and out-of-range coordinates fail validation.

cases.title: Versioned boundary
cases.expected: Changing pilot geometry increments version and invalidates previous aggregate scope.

cases.title: Station identity
cases.expected: Similar names and rail/tram/bus facility variants require canonical reviewed IDs.

cases.title: Entrance precision
cases.expected: Station-centre location never becomes a claimed exact entrance.

cases.title: Boundary retrieval margin
cases.expected: Outside-pilot retrieval rows do not leak into pilot totals without a labelled outside context.

cases.title: Licence/access gate
cases.expected: A discovered public page with unapproved reuse cannot enable automated bulk ingestion.

cases.title: Source independence
cases.expected: A derived council map/table retains lineage to its primary source family.

cases.title: Idempotent replay
cases.expected: Re-running identical source snapshot does not double counts.

cases.title: Shared location multiplicity
cases.expected: Distinct legitimate events at the same anonymised point are retained.

cases.title: Missing persistent IDs
cases.expected: Repeated source rows with missing IDs preserve within-snapshot multiplicity and import idempotency.

cases.title: Source revision
cases.expected: Changed classification/location creates traceable revision without counting old and new as separate events.

cases.title: Missing month
cases.expected: Unavailable month remains missing; no fake zero or imputation.

cases.title: Source taxonomy
cases.expected: Combined violence-and-sexual-offences cannot produce an invented sexual-only street filter.

cases.title: Force duplication
cases.expected: BTP provenance retained; geographic import plus force-specific import do not double-count records.

cases.title: Query limits
cases.expected: Oversized polygon response is split/checkpointed safely or marked incomplete, never silently truncated.

cases.title: Source-period labels
cases.expected: Each publication displays its actual period; metadata lookup does not relabel an older snapshot.

cases.title: No live alert from history
cases.expected: A historical count increase cannot pass current-notice alert eligibility.

cases.title: Suppression
cases.expected: Withheld source categories/locations are not reconstructed through enrichment.

cases.title: Heavy backfill separation
cases.expected: Long ingestion runs outside short scheduled request path and resumes from checkpoint.

cases.title: Failed fetch
cases.expected: Provider timeout retains appropriate stale/unknown state and does not mark all notices resolved.

cases.title: Re-fetch old content
cases.expected: FetchedAt changes without renewing source observation/validity.

cases.title: Partial snapshot
cases.expected: Records absent from incomplete fetch are not treated as removed/resolved.

cases.title: Scope fidelity
cases.expected: Line-wide status does not generate invented station entrance/lift closure.

cases.title: Future validity
cases.expected: Planned disruption appears as scheduled, not active before effective start.

cases.title: Overnight help schedule
cases.expected: Friday 21:30–02:30 is evaluated correctly into Saturday and through relevant DST transitions.

cases.title: Inventory versus condition
cases.expected: Mapped lamp and lit=yes do not create lights-working-now or guaranteed-safety claims.

cases.title: Registration versus availability
cases.expected: Registered haven displays unconfirmed availability unless appropriate evidence exists.

cases.title: Schema drift
cases.expected: Unexpected source schema is quarantined with safe previous state and operational warning.

cases.title: Permission blocked partner
cases.expected: BID/private radio network stays blocked without explicit approved source agreement.

cases.title: Conditional response
cases.expected: 304/ETag handling preserves source publication time and correct snapshot metadata.

cases.title: Scheduled-worker budget
cases.expected: Worker respects configured timeout/checkpoints and can be invoked/tested without assuming preview cron runs.

cases.title: Private intake
cases.expected: New observation is unreadable through public feed/evidence routes.

cases.title: Role spoofing
cases.expected: Client-provided moderator/sourceKind claims cannot grant authority.

cases.title: Owner isolation
cases.expected: Member cannot read or change another member report.

cases.title: Area-scoped reviewer
cases.expected: Moderator restricted to one pilot cannot access another pilot private queue.

cases.title: Identity redaction
cases.expected: Disallowed identifying narrative cannot appear in public summaries or notice sources.

cases.title: No police submission claim
cases.expected: Submission UI distinguishes app intake from official reporting and never displays police-notified falsely.

cases.title: Review is not truth
cases.expected: Approved community summary retains reviewed-community evidence class.

cases.title: Concurrent review
cases.expected: Stale expectedRevision returns conflict instead of overwriting a newer correction.

cases.title: Withdrawal
cases.expected: Owner withdrawal cancels pending publication and applies policy to derived public summaries.

cases.title: Intake kill switch
cases.expected: Server rejects/defers live public intake when feature gate/staffing is disabled while public help remains accessible.

cases.title: Duplicate privacy
cases.expected: Candidate duplicate response does not expose another user private submission.

cases.title: Typed predicates
cases.expected: Illegal subject/predicate/object combinations fail schema/database validation.

cases.title: Qualified evidence
cases.expected: Published relation requires applicable provenance, method and allowed evidence visibility.

cases.title: Month-only police evidence
cases.expected: Nearby monthly police record creates contextual relation only, not individual report confirmation.

cases.title: Public ID is not case reference
cases.expected: Police API id never joins to user official crime-reference field.

cases.title: Unknown precision
cases.expected: Missing spatial/temporal precision cannot score as an exact match.

cases.title: Shared original source
cases.expected: Two copied posts remain one evidence family, not independent confirmation.

cases.title: Nontransitive similarity
cases.expected: A~B and B~C do not auto-collapse A and C as identical incident.

cases.title: Undo merge
cases.expected: Candidate cluster merge can be reversed with lineage preserved.

cases.title: Retraction cascade
cases.expected: Retracted source assertion invalidates current dependent explanations/projections.

cases.title: No private graph inference
cases.expected: Unauthorised nodes cannot be inferred through paths/counts/neighbour lists/errors.

cases.title: Bounded traversal
cases.expected: Depth/node/query limits hold before expensive execution.

cases.title: Allegation preservation
cases.expected: Official source wording remains allegation/report where applicable, not adjudicated guilt.

cases.title: Explicit preference differences
cases.expected: Two synthetic users following different stations see distinct relevant items with accurate reason codes.

cases.title: No demographic risk inference
cases.expected: No gender/ethnicity/home-address field is required or used in relevance.

cases.title: Personal cache isolation
cases.expected: User A cannot receive user B private/personalised response through cache.

cases.title: Unsubscribe after enqueue
cases.expected: Pending notification is suppressed after a user withdraws channel/topic permission.

cases.title: Idempotent delivery scheduling
cases.expected: Replay does not create duplicate outbox/inbox items for same revision/subscription/channel.

cases.title: Retracted before dispatch
cases.expected: Dispatcher rechecks current notice and cancels stale queued revision.

cases.title: Correction audience
cases.expected: Previously notified recipient can see necessary correction even when ordinary topic ordering changes.

cases.title: Quiet hours/DST
cases.expected: Overnight windows and timezone transition rules work without duplicate or missed unintended dispatch.

cases.title: Expiry is not resolution
cases.expected: Expired notice displays freshness limitation, not confirmed problem solved.

cases.title: Historical digest isolation
cases.expected: Opting into digest never authorises urgent alerts from historical counts.

cases.title: In-app first
cases.expected: Disabled push does not break saved feed/inbox.

cases.title: Generic lockscreen
cases.expected: Notification content does not reveal report narrative, live location or sensitive preference.

cases.title: Public access
cases.expected: Map/list/help available without sign-in or location permission.

cases.title: Three areas
cases.expected: All area selectors and coverage states functional with no Westminster seed fallback.

cases.title: Accessible list
cases.expected: Map tile failure still permits useful text navigation and source inspection.

cases.title: Keyboard/mobile
cases.expected: Core tasks work at narrow width, keyboard-only and without colour-dependent statuses.

cases.title: History versus now
cases.expected: Testers can identify period/source and cannot reasonably mistake historical layer for active incident feed.

cases.title: No all-clear on empty
cases.expected: No relevant source notices is labelled as limited coverage, not guaranteed safe.

cases.title: Uncertain help availability
cases.expected: Unknown/registered/scheduled/confirmed states render distinctly.

cases.title: Original/current notice
cases.expected: Old bookmarked notification opens current corrected status.

cases.title: Content rendering
cases.expected: Injected HTML/script in source/report is displayed as inert text or rejected.

cases.title: Launch insufficiency
cases.expected: No real community history returns insufficient_comparable_data with null estimate.

cases.title: No n=3 inference
cases.expected: Three borough totals cannot pass intended longitudinal association eligibility.

cases.title: Shared source lineage
cases.expected: Police dataset plus its republished dashboard cannot count as independent corroboration.

cases.title: Unit mismatch
cases.expected: Mismatched geography vintage/category/time grain fails comparison or produces explicit ineligible state.

cases.title: Constant/sparse/missing
cases.expected: Degenerate values do not produce fake coefficients or significance.

cases.title: Dependence disclaimer
cases.expected: Inferential result without documented dependence/multiplicity plan is blocked from publication.

cases.title: No risk probability
cases.expected: Coefficient never rendered as personal risk, percentage confirmed or causality.

cases.title: Privacy slices
cases.expected: Unsupported overlapping rare-count query combinations are denied.

cases.title: Synthetic separation
cases.expected: Synthetic analytic result cannot become an empirical public finding.

cases.title: SSRF/redirect control
cases.expected: Loopback/private/link-local target and unsafe redirects are rejected by source fetch layer.

cases.title: Secrets
cases.expected: Service keys, tokens and credentials do not appear in browser bundle/logs/export.

cases.title: RLS views/RPCs
cases.expected: Public role cannot bypass policy through views, joins, RPC or service-role proxy endpoint.

cases.title: Deletion propagation
cases.expected: Deletion/withdrawal policy covers graph projections, caches, indexes and pending delivery.

cases.title: No sensitive logging
cases.expected: Reports/contact details/precise locations are absent from telemetry and error messages.

cases.title: No LLM instruction execution
cases.expected: Source/report prompt injection cannot execute URL fetch, database query or tool instruction.

cases.title: Demo tenant isolation
cases.expected: Synthetic records/accounts cannot trigger live subscriber messages or contaminate real analysis.

cases.title: Abuse limits
cases.expected: Bounded body, rate/concurrency and query limits enforced server-side, not only browser.

cases.title: Role revocation
cases.expected: Revoked partner/moderator loses read/write access and queued publishing permissions.

cases.title: Legal/operations gate
cases.expected: Unresolved launch requirements leave affected public features off; no invented legal signoff.

cases.title: Report-to-correction journey
cases.expected: Synthetic report → moderation → graph → relevant inbox → retraction runs end to end.

cases.title: Real-source honesty
cases.expected: Each connector status accurately distinguishes live tested, fixture, blocked and unavailable.

cases.title: Build evidence
cases.expected: Build/type/unit/integration outcomes recorded from actual commands, not assumed.

cases.title: Deployment target
cases.expected: Deployment runs only against specifically authorised target; no fabricated live URL.

cases.title: Rollback exercise
cases.expected: Operator can disable intake/push and retract bad content without deleting valid history.

cases.title: Dependency outage
cases.expected: Map provider, transport source and database failure modes are tested with safe user states.

cases.title: No production reset
cases.expected: Parallel tests/backfills cannot reset shared production database.

cases.title: Source family versus claim origin
cases.expected: Distinct events from one publisher are retained; copied claims across publishers share origin lineage; unknown origin is not independent corroboration.
